there was a last peace here.

They raged.
They ran amok at whatever lay nearest.

One infantryman emptied his machine gun into a crowd of his colleagues. Then a tank rolled over him from behind.

That tank swung its main gun toward an identical vehicle ahead. But before it could fire, a grenade was dropped down its muzzle, and it went up in a roaring blast.

The tank it had been aiming at took no notice from start to finish and kept scattering shells into the sky. A highly mobile warrior is not easily hit by that kind of fire. But at last one shell went through the wing of an <ruby>S-14<rt>Werewolf</rt></ruby>.

One craft tumbled out of the sky, and its comrades stared at his tragedy in a daze.
They had not turned into beasts.

Only the warriors protected by adamantine armor... were left to taste the helplessness of naked humans in this small world.

They raged.
They ran amok at whatever lay nearest.

One infantryman emptied his machine gun into a crowd of his colleagues. Then a tank rolled over him from behind.

That tank swung its main gun toward an identical vehicle ahead. But before it could fire, a grenade was dropped down its muzzle, and it went up in a roaring blast.

The tank it had been aiming at took no notice from start to finish and kept scattering shells into the sky. A highly mobile warrior is not easily hit by that kind of fire. But at last one shell went through the wing of an S-14Werewolf.

One craft tumbled out of the sky, and its comrades stared at his tragedy in a daze.
They had not turned into beasts.

Only the warriors protected by adamantine armor... were left to taste the helplessness of naked humans in this small world.

Major Gargett, repeating his empty reprimands, could be called one of the calmest among them. Which was exactly why he stood out, and why, to the beasts, he perhaps looked like choice prey・・.
